description: This file contains utility functions for testing socket communication, including sending requests and responses, reading data, and draining socket streams, specifically for the Chromium project's net module.

methods.name: SendRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request through a socket, verifies server response, and sends a server response.

methods.name: ReadDataOfExpectedLength
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data from a socket, ensuring the expected length is received.

methods.name: SendServerResponse
methods.description: Sends a fixed HTTP 404 response through a socket.

methods.name: DrainStreamSocket
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from a socket into a buffer.
